sourceDependency: DUB-17 frozen Theorem 2.6 / DUB-18 Corollary 8.2 -> symmetric-power continuation -> arithmetic automorphy -> residual Galois association -> original parabolic Hecke realization -> period surjectivity -> matching cusp-form lower dimension bound -> regular differential dimension -> canonical-divisor finiteness and local derivative order formulas -> integral local differentials.
routeAdjustment: Reuse the original finite-uniformizer extension, Dedekind-chart center identity and proved residue algebraicity. Pinned localization transport gives essential finite type directly. Select only the external cotangent and residue engines, using pinned exactness and Nakayama. This avoids the external general two-affine-chart/local-model framework and the longer ramification-restriction proof of local derivative integrality. A proposition-valued source definition is a theorem in the adaptation so the full declaration-kind linter passes.
discharged: Every actual original valuation ring is essentially of finite type over the constants, hence has a finite local differential module. The proved finite extension over its actual uniformizer supplies a finite integral-closure chart, and the proved center identity gives its localization. The actual algebraic residue field is separable in characteristic zero. Pinned cotangent exactness and Nakayama then show that the actual uniformizer derivative generates the integral local differential module. Consequently the derivative of every integral original-field function has integral local coefficient and nonnegative local differential order. No local finiteness, residue separability, local generation or unramifiedness premise remains in the original consumers.
remaining: Canonical-divisor finite support still requires control away from the finite different-ideal and pole loci. Riemann--Roch, regular differential dimension, geometric genus and actual analytic cusp-form realization remain required for the matching lower bound. Period surjectivity, Hecke/Galois realization, the adic system and symmetric-power continuation remain open. DUB-17--20 OPEN; 16/20.
